basic_details.job_title: CSIR TKDL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Project Associate, Senior Project Associate Posts

age_limit.age_details: SPA: Max 40 years. Project Associate-I: Max 35 years. Age relaxable for reserved categories.
age_limit.details: Senior Project Associate (SPA): Maximum 40 years. Project Associate-I (PAT-I): Maximum 35 years. Age relaxable for candidates of reserved/statutory category as per CSIR/Govt. of India rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree / Integrated Masters in Sanskrit, B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgy/Metallurgical Engg. or Master's Degree in Chemistry, Master's /Integrated Master's Degree in Agriculture/ Agronomy/ Horticulture/ Animal Science/any branch of Veterinary Sciences/Zoology, B.E./B.Tech/Master's/Integrated Master's degree in Natural Sciences.
qualification.details: Senior Project Associate (Sanskrit): Master's degree / Integrated Masters in Sanskrit language from recognized University or equivalent AND three years of relevant experience Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or S&T Organizations and activities and services OR Doctoral Degree in Sanskrit from a recognized University or equivalent and 2 year experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organization and Scientific activities and services. Project Associate-I (Metallurgy): B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgy/Metallurgical Engg. or Master's Degree in Chemistry or equivalent. Project Associate-I (Agriculture): Master's /Integrated Master's Degree in Agriculture/ Agronomy/ Horticulture/ Animal Science/any branch of Veterinary Sciences/Zoology from a recognized University or equivalent. Experience in documenting of Traditional Agricultural Knowledge will be preferred. Project Associate-I (Patents): B.E./B.Tech/Master's/Integrated Master's degree in Natural Sciences from recognized University or equivalent. Proficiency in Patent Analytics/Patent Informatics/ PG Diploma in IPR, good written and oral skills in English.

salary_details.pay_scale: SPA: Rs. 42,000/-+ HRA. Project Associate-I: Rs. 31,000/-+ HRA or Rs. 25,000/-+HRA.
salary_details.details: Senior Project Associate (SPA): Rs. 42,000/-+ HRA Project Associate-I (PAT-I): (a) Rs. 31,000/-+ HRA for those candidates who have qualified CSIR UGC/ICAR/ ICMR/ NET incl. lectureship/assistant professorship or GATE OR those who have qualified National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions. (b) Rs. 25,000/-+HRA for others who do not fall under (a) above.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR TKDL Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR TKDL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR TKDL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR TKDL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR TKDL Project Personnel recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the CSIR TKDL Project Personnel recruitment is 23rd September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Personnel at CSIR TKDL?
faq.answer: CSIR TKDL is recruiting for a total of 5 Project Personnel posts across various disciplines. These positions are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Project Personnel posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications vary by post, ranging from a Master's degree in Sanskrit, Chemistry, Agriculture, or Natural Sciences to B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgy. Please refer to the detailed eligibility criteria for specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years for Senior Project Associate and 35 years for Project Associate-I. Age relaxation is applicable for candidates belonging to reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Personnel roles?
faq.answer: The salary varies by post. Senior Project Associates can expect Rs. 42,000/-+ HRA, while Project Associate-I positions offer Rs. 31,000/-+ HRA or Rs. 25,000/-+HRA depending on qualifications and qualifying national exams.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the CSIR TKDL recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Personnel posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Personnel positions at CSIR TKDL typically involves a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any part of India apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment is open for candidates across India. The CSIR TKDL Unit is located in New Delhi, but applications are accepted from all eligible candidates nationwide.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for Project Personnel positions on a contract basis. The duration and terms of the contract will be as per the project requirements and CSIR guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to visit the official CSIR website for the most accurate and up-to-date information.
